# brig image build

Build a base image with mkosi

## Synopsis

```text
brig image build
```

## Description

Build a base image with mkosi: Fedora with OpenShell from brig's signed
package repository. Building needs no root privileges but takes a while.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--fedora int` | Fedora release (default from config.yaml) |
| `--openshell string` | OpenShell version, e.g. 0.1.2 (default: newest in the repository) |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
